description: Finds at-risk and lost customers in an orders CSV by comparing each customer with their own buying pattern, with yearly revenue at risk, repeat rate and revenue concentration. Use for customer retention, churn analysis, or win-back lists. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include customer names or emails from the file, so they reach the model. It can't contact anyone.

as_of.description: Date to measure from, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is the newest order

columns.description: Column names by field (date, customer, amount), when detection fails

date_format.description: dmy or mdy, needed only if the tool reports that dates are ambiguous

limit.description: Most customers to return, highest priority first, default 100. 0 returns only the summary

name: customers_check_lapsed
title: Find customers who stopped buying
